findings.title: Supabase SERVICE_ROLE_KEY committed in CLAUDE.md
findings.description: Full service_role JWT bypasses all 130 RLS policies. In git history across 4 commits.
findings.exploit_scenario: Clone repo -> decode JWT -> direct Supabase API calls with full admin access to all 32 tables
findings.impact: Complete database compromise, read/write/delete all financial records, PII, salary data
findings.recommendation: 1) Rotate key in Supabase dashboard immediately 2) Replace values in CLAUDE.md with placeholders 3) Scrub git history with BFG Repo Cleaner

findings.title: GitHub Actions pinned to mutable version tags
findings.description: actions/checkout@v4 and actions/setup-node@v4 use mutable tags instead of SHA pins
findings.exploit_scenario: Attacker compromises v4 tag -> CI runs malicious code on next push
findings.impact: Code execution in CI, potential secret exfiltration
findings.recommendation: Pin to commit SHAs: actions/checkout@<sha> actions/setup-node@<sha>

findings.title: No CODEOWNERS file
findings.description: No mandatory review gates on sensitive paths (auth, middleware, RLS migrations)
findings.exploit_scenario: Contributor pushes to sensitive paths without designated reviewer approval
findings.impact: Unreviewed changes to auth/RLS could introduce access control bypass
findings.recommendation: Create .github/CODEOWNERS with rules for middleware.ts, supabase/migrations/, src/lib/auth.ts

findings.title: Claims self-approval not prevented
findings.description: approveClaim does not check submitted_by === user.id unlike approvals/actions.ts
findings.exploit_scenario: Finance user submits project claim then approves it themselves
findings.recommendation: Add self-approval check: if (claim.created_by === user.id) throw new Error('Cannot approve own claim')

findings.title: Claims RLS excludes Principal from UPDATE
findings.description: claims_approvers_update policy allows finance+hr but not principal. Server Action permits principal. DB will silently reject.
findings.exploit_scenario: Principal tries to approve claim -> 0 rows updated -> silent failure
findings.impact: Functional bug, not security. Principal approval workflow broken at DB level.
findings.recommendation: Add principal to claims_approvers_update RLS policy
